title: Ho Tongtong Ihuthononku
chord: Bb · G · Am · F · C · G · F · Bb
lyrics:
Tu joloM o Debatangku
Sai use do rohangkon
Sai pasiat tangianghu
Dohot iluilungkon
Husolsoli do rohangku
Na gok dosa i tongtong

Ai godang ariaringku
Na hubahen ambolong
Sai jotjot do hutadingkon
DalanMi na tigor i
Kristen au hape hutondong
Dalan hamagoan i

Ala ni~i tungki rohangku
Jongjong di adopanMi
Sai asi rohaM Tuhanku
Sesa nasa dosangki
Haburjuon dimangmangkon
Rohangkon nuaeng di Ho

Naeng tu Surgo hutujuhon
Jesus taiti au gogo
Mangihuthon Ho, Tuhanku
I ma las ni rohangki
I ma naeng padanhononku
Dok ma amenmi disi
